description_en: Queries the information of a member
name: GetAccount

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the information of tags. Valid values:

false (default value)
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回标签信息。取值：

false（默认值）：不返回。
true：返回
parameters.name: include_tags

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member

AccountName.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account name of the member

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the member

EmailStatus.description_en:
The status of the modification for the email address bound to the member. Valid values:

WAIT_MODIFY: in progress
CANCELLED: canceled
EXPIRED: expired

If the value of this parameter is empty, no modification is performed for the email address
EmailStatus.description_zh:
邮箱状态。取值：

空：不存在邮箱修改记录。
WAIT_MODIFY：正在修改中。
CANCELLED：修改取消。
EXPIRED：修改过期

JoinMethod.description_en:
The way in which the member joins the resource directory. Valid values:

invited: The member is invited to join the resource directory.
created: The member is directly created in the resource directory
JoinMethod.description_zh:
成员加入方式。取值：

invited：邀请。
created：创建

JoinTime.description_en: The time when the member joined the resource directory

Location.description_en: The location of the member in the resource directory
Location.description_zh: 成员所在资源目录的位置

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the member was modified

ResourceDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the resource directory

ResourceDirectoryPath.description_en: The path of the member in the resource directory
ResourceDirectoryPath.description_zh: 成员在资源目录中的路径ID（RDPath）

Status.description_en:
The status of the member. Valid values:

CreateSuccess: The member is created.
PromoteVerifying: The upgrade of the member is being confirmed.
PromoteFailed: The upgrade of the member fails.
PromoteExpired: The upgrade of the member expires.
PromoteCancelled: The upgrade of the member is canceled.
PromoteSuccess: The member is upgraded.
InviteSuccess: The member accepts the invitation
Status.description_zh:
成员加入状态。取值：

CreateSuccess：创建成功。
PromoteVerifying：升级确认中。
PromoteFailed：升级失败。
PromoteExpired：升级过期。
PromoteCancelled：升级取消。
PromoteSuccess：升级成功。
InviteSuccess：邀请成功

Tags.description_en: The tags that are added to the member

Type.description_en:
The type of the member. Valid values:

CloudAccount: cloud account
ResourceAccount: resource account
Type.description_zh:
成员类型。取值：

CloudAccount：云账号。
ResourceAccount：资源账号
